OPERATIONAL COMPARISON

In-House Field Surveyors vs. SolarSite Co.

Why leading solar operations directors are transitioning from internal field fleets to on-demand coordinated survey dispatch.

Operational Dimension Managing In-House Surveyors Coordinated via SolarSite Co.
Cost Structure Fixed monthly payroll, benefits, overtime, and idle labor during rain or market slowdowns. 100% Variable On-Demand: Pay only per completed, QA-verified survey package.
Vehicle & Tool Liability Fleet leases, commercial auto insurance, ladders, drone registration, gas cards, and repairs. Zero Equipment Overhead: All network surveyors provide certified safety equipment.
Geographic Expansion Months spent recruiting, vetting, and training local surveyors in new counties or states. Instant Multi-Market Scale: Active coverage ready across 14+ major solar states.
Deliverable Consistency Varying photo quality, forgotten panel dead-fronts, and inconsistent hand-drawn sketches. Strict 36-Photo Standard: Standardized CAD dimensioning and electrical parameter reports.
CAD Revision Rate Industry average 22%–28% drafting revisions due to incomplete field data. < 3% Revisions: Triple-checked by internal engineering desk prior to release.
Average Turnaround Time 7–14 days depending on internal surveyor schedule backlogs. 48–72 Hours: Guaranteed dispatch SLA with 24hr rush tier available.
